/.title: Happier — open-source app for Claude Code, Codex & 11 more
/.description: Run Claude Code, Codex and 11 more agents from your phone, browser or desktop. Open-source, end-to-end encrypted, self-hostable. Your own subscriptions.
/.ogTitle: Happier — One client for every AI coding agent.
/.ogDescription: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and 9 more — in one end-to-end encrypted app, on every device, on your own subscriptions. Open-source and self-hostable.
/.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and 7 more.

/agents.title: Every AI coding agent Happier runs — 13 and counting
/agents.description: One open-source app for 13 command-line coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and nine more — on your own computers, with your own accounts.
/agents.ogTitle: Every AI coding agent Happier runs
/agents.ogDescription: Thirteen command-line coding agents, one app on your phone, browser and desktop. Each runs on your own computer, under your own subscription or API key.
/agents.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/claude-code.title: Open-source app for Claude Code — Happier
/agents/claude-code.description: Run Claude Code on your own computer and drive it from your phone, browser or desktop. Open-source, end-to-end encrypted, self-hostable, MIT-licensed.
/agents/claude-code.ogDescription: Claude Code keeps running on your own computer, signed in with your own Anthropic account. Happier gives it a phone, a browser tab and a desktop window.
/agents/claude-code.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/codex.title: Codex CLI on your phone — open-source Happier
/agents/codex.description: The openai/codex CLI runs on your computer under your own ChatGPT subscription or API key. Read, approve and steer it from any device. Free, open-source.
/agents/codex.ogTitle: Codex on your phone, from an open-source app
/agents/codex.ogDescription: The openai/codex CLI runs on hardware you own, under your own ChatGPT subscription or API key. Happier is the window onto it from wherever you happen to be.
/agents/codex.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/opencode.title: Open-source app for OpenCode — phone and desktop
/agents/opencode.description: OpenCode runs on hardware you control, with your own opencode auth credentials. Happier adds phone, browser and desktop clients over a self-hostable relay.
/agents/opencode.ogDescription: OpenCode is open source. Happier is open source, MIT-licensed and self-hostable. Neither of them needs a server you do not control.
/agents/opencode.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/cursor.title: Run Cursor Agent CLI from your phone — Happier
/agents/cursor.description: The headless cursor-agent binary on your own computer or server, with the conversation, diffs and approvals on your phone. Open-source and MIT-licensed.
/agents/cursor.ogTitle: Run Cursor Agent CLI from your phone
/agents/cursor.ogDescription: Cursor ships a headless agent that does not need the editor window. Happier runs it on your computer and puts the conversation on your phone.
/agents/cursor.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/gemini.title: Gemini CLI on every device — Happier
/agents/gemini.description: Google’s open-source terminal agent runs in your own environment, including your own Cloud project. Happier carries the session to your phone, encrypted.
/agents/gemini.ogTitle: Gemini CLI on every device you use
/agents/gemini.ogDescription: Google’s open-source terminal agent, running against your own Google Cloud project if that is how your organisation works, readable from a phone.
/agents/gemini.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/github-copilot.title: GitHub Copilot CLI from your phone — Happier
/agents/github-copilot.description: Run the Copilot command-line agent on your computer or build box and drive it from anywhere. Independent open-source client, not a GitHub product.
/agents/github-copilot.ogTitle: GitHub Copilot CLI, driven from your phone
/agents/github-copilot.ogDescription: The Copilot command-line agent, running on your own computer or your own build box, with the session in your pocket.
/agents/github-copilot.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/qwen.title: Open-source app for Qwen Code — Happier
/agents/qwen.description: Qwen Code runs on your own computer with your own account. Happier puts the session on your phone, browser and desktop over an encrypted relay you can run.
/agents/qwen.ogDescription: Qwen Code on your own computer, with the session on your phone. Both halves are open source and neither needs an account with us to be useful.
/agents/qwen.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/kimi.title: Kimi CLI from your phone, browser or desktop
/agents/kimi.description: Moonshot’s terminal coding agent stays on your computer while you read and steer it from anywhere. Free, MIT-licensed and end-to-end encrypted.
/agents/kimi.ogTitle: Kimi CLI from your phone, browser or desktop
/agents/kimi.ogDescription: Moonshot’s terminal agent stays on your computer. The conversation goes wherever you go, encrypted on the way.
/agents/kimi.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/kilo.title: Kilo CLI on your phone, laptop and browser
/agents/kilo.description: One open-source app for Kilo CLI and twelve other command-line coding agents, on your own computers with your own accounts. No seats, no feature gate.
/agents/kilo.ogTitle: Kilo CLI on your phone, laptop and browser
/agents/kilo.ogDescription: One open-source app for Kilo and the twelve other command-line coding agents you might have installed.
/agents/kilo.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/kiro.title: Run Kiro CLI from anywhere — Happier
/agents/kiro.description: AWS’s agentic CLI on your own computer or EC2 box, under your own AWS identity, with the session readable from a phone. Open-source, self-hostable relay.
/agents/kiro.ogTitle: Run Kiro CLI from anywhere you are
/agents/kiro.ogDescription: AWS’s agentic CLI, running under your own AWS identity on your own computer, with an app in front of it.
/agents/kiro.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/auggie.title: Auggie on your phone and desktop — Happier
/agents/auggie.description: Augment Code’s CLI runs on your own computer under your own entitlement. Happier collects its transcript and approvals alongside your other agents.
/agents/auggie.ogTitle: Auggie, on your phone and your desktop
/agents/auggie.ogDescription: Augment Code’s CLI, running on your own computer under your own Augment entitlement, with the conversation on every device you own.
/agents/auggie.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/pi.title: Open-source app for the Pi Coding Agent
/agents/pi.description: Pi brings your own API keys; Happier brings the phone, browser and desktop clients. Neither holds your keys on a server. MIT-licensed and self-hostable.
/agents/pi.ogTitle: Open-source app for the Pi Coding Agent
/agents/pi.ogDescription: Pi brings its own keys and no model of its own. Happier brings the phone, the browser and the desktop app, and no server in the middle.
/agents/pi.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/agents/grok.title: Grok Build CLI from your phone — Happier
/agents/grok.description: xAI’s coding CLI on your own computer, driven from any device. The integration is experimental and this page names what it does not support yet.
/agents/grok.ogTitle: Grok Build CLI from your phone or your desk
/agents/grok.ogDescription: xAI’s coding CLI, running on your own computer with your own xAI account. The Happier integration is experimental, and this page says so before you install anything.
/agents/grok.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/vs/claude-code-remote-control.title: Claude Code Remote Control vs Happier: what each covers
/vs/claude-code-remote-control.description: Remote Control is free and good. It is also unavailable for API keys, gateways, Bedrock, Foundry and ZDR orgs. What each one covers, side by side.
/vs/claude-code-remote-control.ogTitle: Claude Code Remote Control vs Happier
/vs/claude-code-remote-control.ogDescription: What Anthropic’s own remote does well, the five situations it turns itself off in, and what one client for thirteen agents does instead.
/vs/claude-code-remote-control.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/vs/codex-remote.title: Codex from your phone — Codex Remote vs Happier
/vs/codex-remote.description: OpenAI pairs the ChatGPT app to a Mac or Windows PC running Codex. What Remote covers, the five conditions it runs under, and what Happier does instead.
/vs/codex-remote.ogDescription: What OpenAI’s own remote does well, the five conditions it runs under, and what one client for every coding agent does instead.
/vs/codex-remote.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/features/usage-limits.title: Claude Code and Codex usage limits without losing work
/features/usage-limits.description: Hit a Claude Code or Codex usage limit and the session waits out the reset, then carries on — automatically, if you like. Or pool accounts and fall back.
/features/usage-limits.ogTitle: A usage limit should not end your session.
/features/usage-limits.ogDescription: The session holds its place through a usage limit, waits out the reset and picks the work back up — on one account, or across the accounts you pool.
/features/usage-limits.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/features/terminal.title: Claude Code and Codex in your terminal, and in the app
/features/terminal.description: Run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in their own TUI and follow the same session from your phone. Attach over tmux, or hand control back to the app.
/features/terminal.ogTitle: Keep your Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode terminals, or work from the app
/features/terminal.ogDescription: One session, two front ends: the provider’s own TUI in your shell and Happier on your phone. Same session id, same transcript, same queue on both sides of the switch.
/features/terminal.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/security.title: End-to-end encryption in Happier — what the relay sees
/security.description: Session content is sealed on the device that wrote it. The keys, the columns a relay can still read, and what changes under a plaintext storage policy.
/security.ogTitle: End-to-end encryption, with the keys on your own devices
/security.ogDescription: Your session is encrypted under a per-session key on the device that made it, and the relay is handed a sealed copy it has nothing to open. Here is what it can still see — named, not glossed.
/security.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.

/enterprise.title: Self-hosted Happier for teams — SSO, mTLS, your data
/enterprise.description: Run the Happier relay yourself: GitHub org and OIDC group gating, forwarded mTLS, offboarding re-checks, storage policy, retention, Docker with Postgres.
/enterprise.ogTitle: Self-host the Happier relay behind your own SSO
/enterprise.ogDescription: A relay you host, locked to your GitHub org or OIDC groups, with client certificates, offboarding re-checks and a storage policy you choose. MIT-licensed, all of it.
/enterprise.ogImageAlt: The Happier wordmark over the words: One client for every AI coding agent.
